@@U03687@@
(To 涅柔斯.)

@@U03688@@
These are boys we saved from death In the tempest’s wrack and ruin, We warmed them back to life and breath, Knowing each would be a true one. Now with kisses to delight us, They long to love us and to wed, And for the life we gave requite us. Father, on them your favor shed.

@@U03690@@
I praise the economy that wins a double treasure: To practice charity and yet have pleasure!

@@U03692@@
Since you praise our fond endeavor, Father, grant us our request: Let us hold them fast forever To our young immortal breast.

@@U03694@@
Enjoy your pretty catch while you can; make of each lad a splendid man. But never ask for immortality that only 宙斯 can give. The waves that rock you allow not even love a steady stance. So when your fancy’s worn itself thin, and passions on the wane, then shuttle them off once more to shore.

@@U03696@@
Sweet dear lads, fond lovely boys, We love you, we avow it. We wanted everlasting joys, But the gods will not allow it.
translation:
@@U03687@@
（致涅柔斯。）

@@U03688@@
这些是我们从死亡中拯救出来的男孩，在暴风雨的摧残和毁灭中，我们让他们恢复生机和呼吸，知道每个人都会是一个真正的男孩。现在，他们用亲吻来取悦我们，他们渴望爱我们并结婚，因为我们付出的生命回报我们。父亲，您对他们倾注了厚爱。

@@U03690@@
我赞叹双宝经济：行善又享乐！

@@U03692@@
既然您赞扬了我们的热心努力，天父，请满足我们的请求：让我们将它们永远牢牢地抱在我们年轻不朽的胸膛里。

@@U03694@@
趁你还可以的时候，享受你漂亮的捕获物；让每个小伙子都成为出色的男人。但永远不要要求只有宙斯才能给予的永生。摇动你的波浪甚至不喜欢稳定的立场。因此，当你的幻想逐渐消退、激情消退时，请再次将它们送上岸。

@@U03696@@
亲爱的小伙子们，可爱的男孩们，我们爱你们，我们承认这一点。我们想要永恒的欢乐，但诸神不允许。
